# telnyx_agent_gateway (Data Source)

An Agent Gateway, an LLM and tool gateway that runs as a peer on one of the account's WireGuard Interfaces. It has no update, so every change replaces it; create waits until it is ready.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Identifies the instance.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) When the instance was created.
- `engine` (String) The gateway engine.
- `engine_version` (String) The engine version the instance runs.
- `gateway_url` (String) The base URL of the instance's API, `http://<address>:4000`, where the address is the instance's peer address on the WireGuard Interface. Reachable only from hosts on the instance's *Network*, and every request to it carries a key from this API. `null` until the instance is `ready`.
- `name` (String) A label for people; `null` when none was given.
- `network_id` (String) The [*Network*](https://developers.telnyx.com/docs/network/overview) the WireGuard Interface belongs to.
- `status` (String) Where the instance is in its lifecycle. `pending`: created and waiting to start. `provisioning`: starting. `ready`: running, with its `gateway_url` set. `failed`: did not start in time; delete it. `deleting`: being removed.
- `wireguard_interface_id` (String) The WireGuard Interface the instance joins as a peer.
